1. Acceptance of Terms

Organizers are responsible for the accuracy of their event listings, tier descriptions, refund policies, and on-site execution. Payments are processed by third-party providers. NextVibe charges service and platform fees disclosed at checkout. Refunds are governed by the organizer's policy on each event page. Chargebacks issued in bad faith may result in account suspension.
